Open the service from «📊 My subscription» and tap «Subscription link».

First check your internet and the phone's date/time, then tap «Refresh info».

3) How do I renew?
Choose the service from «♾ Renew» and buy a renewal plan.

4) Where is support?
Send your message via the «📩 Support» button.
